# window_manager upstream

This source copy is pinned from:

- Repository: <https://github.com/boyan01/window_manager>
- Package path: `packages/window_manager`
- Commit: `6fae92d21b4c80ce1b8f71c1190d7970cf722bd4`

The copy is used because it supports applying `window_manager` operations to
Flutter engines created by `desktop_multi_window`. The upstream MIT license is
preserved in `LICENSE`.
